settings.title: Your number is your membership
settings.text: Every hoodie in Drop 001 carries its own number. That number is your place in Visionair Society.

settings.title: Heavyweight 500 gsm
settings.text: Boxy oversized fit in black, S–2XL.

settings.title: No restock
settings.text: When a design is gone, it stays gone.

settings.title: Pop-up first
settings.text: Pop-up in Europe first. Online 7 days later.

settings.question: What does Founding Member access include?
settings.answer: The private channel, first access to Drop 002 and an invite to the pop-up.

settings.question: How does the fit run?
settings.answer: Boxy oversized. Check the size guide on the product page (cm and inch).

settings.question: Can I return it?
settings.answer: Yes, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal (EU).

settings.question: When does it ship?
settings.answer: Shipping details are being confirmed and will be announced before the drop.
